coreMemory.chinese: 会；将会（假设情况）；愿意；想要；宁愿；过去常常；本来会；本来可以
coreMemory.english: aux. used for an imagined or conditional situation；aux. used to make a polite request or express a preference；aux. used to describe a repeated action in the past；aux. used with have to talk about an unreal past result
coreMemory.structure: would like to do something /ˈwʊd ˈlaɪk ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（想要做某事）；would rather do something /ˈwʊd ˈræðɚ ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（宁愿做某事）；would you mind doing something /ˈwʊd ˈjuː ˈmaɪnd ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（你介意做某事吗）；would be better /ˈwʊd ˈbiː ˈbɛtɚ/（会更好）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ would like to does something → ✅ would like to do something；❌ would you mind to doing something → ✅ would you mind doing something

commonErrors.note: 在“would like to do something”中，这个 to 是不定式标记，后面必须接动词原形。do 只是语法占位符，真实表达要把它换成 finish、check 等符合语境的动词原形。

commonErrors.wrong: would you mind to doing something
commonErrors.note: “would you mind doing something”在本义下要求动词 -ing 形式；doing 是语法占位符，应换成具体动词的 -ing 形式，前面不要额外加 to。

coreMemory.directSynonym: used to /juːst tə/（过去常常）；was willing to /ˈwɑz ˈwɪlɪŋ ˈtuː/（过去愿意做）；would like to /ˈwʊd ˈlaɪk ˈtuː/（想要；愿意）；tended to /ˈtɛndɪd ˈtuː/（过去往往会）
coreMemory.derivatives: 本词暂无需额外强记的高频派生词
coreMemory.example: I would like to review the feedback once more.

meanings.english: used for an imagined or conditional situation
meanings.example: It would be better to add a clear example here.
meanings.translation: 在这里加一个清楚的例子会更好。

meanings.english: used to make a polite request or express a preference
meanings.example: I would like to review the feedback once more.

meanings.english: used to describe a repeated action in the past
meanings.example: After class, we would often review together.
meanings.translation: 以前下课后，我们常常一起复习。

meanings.english: used with have to talk about an unreal past result
meanings.example: I would have called you if I had known.
meanings.translation: 如果我知道，我本来会给你打电话。

synonyms.difference: would 与 used to 在本卡的一个常用义项下意思接近。used to 与 would 都可描述过去反复发生的动作；状态和过去事实通常只能用 used to。
would 与 was willing to 在本卡的一个常用义项下意思接近。was willing to 只对应 would 表示过去意愿的义项，不表示假设结果。
would 与 would like to 在本卡的一个常用义项下意思接近。would like to 是礼貌表达愿望的固定结构；would 单独使用的范围更广。
would 与 tended to 在本卡的一个常用义项下意思接近。tended to 表示过去经常出现的倾向；would 可叙述过去反复发生的动作。

antonyms.usage: would 与 would not 在本卡的一个明确义项下形成对比。would 可表达假设结果、过去习惯或礼貌意愿；would not 否定相应结果或意愿。

confusables.difference: will 表示“用意志的力量驱使；决意；愿意”；would 在本卡核心搭配“would like to do something”中表示“会”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
could 表示“可以；能”；would 在本卡核心搭配“would like to do something”中表示“会”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。

studyFocus.coreMeaning: 先掌握“会；将会（假设情况）”这个核心义，再对比另外 3 个常用义项，辨别不同语境。

studyFocus.mustUseExample: I would like to review the feedback once more.（我想再看一遍反馈。）
